game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the harbor master must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the harbor master slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the harbor master slips through safely. Each round, rogue waves strike the harbor gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stealth value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from rogue waves in Lighthouse Point: keep the stealth meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: stealth drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lighthouse Point'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Lighthouse Point.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while stealth > 0.
